fr_html: Le PRESIDENT donne lecture de l'article 8 de son avant-projet. Cet article fournit, selon lui, une meilleure expression des idées contenues dans l'article 10 du projet Root—Phillimore.
en_html: The PRESIDENT read Article 8 of his draft scheme. In his opinion this gave better expression to the ideas contained in Article 10 of the Root—Phillimore plan.
